name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
summary: Red lentils simmered in a sweet-tangy tomato sauce, piled on bread. Vegan.
instructions: Rinse the lentils. Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and chili powder for 30 seconds, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the lentils, diced tomatoes, brown sugar, and 500 mL water. Stir well.
Simmer 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils are soft and the mixture is thick and spoonable. Add water if it dries out.
Season with salt and pepper. Pile onto bread or toasted buns and serve.

substitutions.substitute: gluten-free buns or serve over rice
substitutions.costNote: GF bread costs more; rice is cheaper

glutenFree.notes: The lentil filling is naturally gluten-free. Serve on gluten-free buns or over rice.

budgetNotes: Red lentils cook fast and thicken on their own — no need for a thickener.
Serve on buns, over rice, or over a baked potato.
